title: Whatever you do to one side

ask.text: Write the claim that stands.

hints.text: Tare on the near pan, contents on the far. Rell's balance, and it is level.
Whatever you lift off the near pan comes off the far pan too.
The near pan is carrying a lip of 5, and the far pan is carrying 13.

worldFraming.text: Rell weighs everything she owns, including her boots, including you.

ask.text: Write the claim that stands.

hints.text: Tare on the near pan, contents on the far. Rell's balance, and it is level.
Sharing both pans by a socket is sharing by something that may be nothing.
Take the far pan off the near one and 3 of the socket is left standing.

worldFraming.text: Rell weighs everything she owns, including her boots, including you.
